aggregationMethodExplanation.microAverage: Micro-average pools all entities across all categories equally: Precision = Total TP / Total Parsed, Recall = Total TP / Total Expected, F1 = 2PR / (P+R). Note: Micro-average is heavily weighted by high-volume categories like Skills (187 expected items).
aggregationMethodExplanation.macroAverage: Macro-average calculates the unweighted arithmetic mean of Precision, Recall, and F1 across all 8 distinct resume categories, giving equal weight to Work Experience, Education, Projects, Certifications, etc.
aggregationMethodExplanation.fieldVsEntityDistinction: Entity detection evaluates whether the parent record was identified (TP / FP / FN). Field extraction evaluates whether individual attributes (degree, dates, roleTitle, etc.) were accurately captured strictly on successfully detected entities.

ocrStatus.note: OCR engine is unavailable in local runtime. Scanned documents will gracefully fallback without crashing.

groundTruthAudit.sourceTextFidelity: 100% of expected entities across all 20 scenarios are verified against the raw text of their respective source documents.

prioritizedImprovementBacklog.issue: Wrapped bullet continuation lines falsely matched by Pattern B as company headers
prioritizedImprovementBacklog.proposedFix: Require rawLine in Pattern B to not be part of bullet continuation, not end with punctuation, and verify it starts with capital company naming tokens.

prioritizedImprovementBacklog.issue: Empty lines between project title and bullets in DOCX prevent isStandaloneHeader from triggering
prioritizedImprovementBacklog.proposedFix: Look ahead to the next non-empty line rather than rawLines[i + 1] when evaluating nextIsBullet and nextIsPlatform.

prioritizedImprovementBacklog.issue: Full-text link extraction captures candidate email domains and project-scoped repository links into top-level candidate links
prioritizedImprovementBacklog.proposedFix: Filter out the candidate email domain from portfolio extraction; scope project repository links to their respective project records and avoid duplicate promotion to top-level professionalLinks.

prioritizedImprovementBacklog.issue: Full-text skill dictionary matching captures contextual technologies mentioned in bullets as candidate skills
prioritizedImprovementBacklog.proposedFix: Prioritize skills listed under the explicit SKILLS section; tag technologies mentioned only in project or experience bullets with source: BULLET_CONTEXT rather than unverified candidate skill.

prioritizedImprovementBacklog.issue: DOCX table header row (| Certification Name | Issuing Organization) parsed as a certification record
prioritizedImprovementBacklog.proposedFix: Add table header token filter ignoring rows containing "Certification Name", "Issuing Organization", "Issue Date".

prioritizedImprovementBacklog.issue: Two-column PDF text flow interleaves sidebar skills and education with main column project headers
prioritizedImprovementBacklog.proposedFix: Improve column coordinate segmentation when splitting PDF streams into section blocks.
